facts.fact: The Ministry of the Interior says L.I. 2523, effective 9 June 2026, requires organisations to verify identities through the NIA biometric system or approved match-on-card devices, and urges banks, telecoms, hospitals, educational institutions and agencies to complete onboarding onto the IVSP, with a transition period from 27 July to 2 November 2026.

systems.platform: NIA biometric verification against the National Identity Register

systems.system: Ghana Card biometric verification by organisations
